method: spectral flux (1024-pt Hann, 1 ms hop, log magnitude), peak-picked; tempo from onset autocorrelation (80-160 BPM) refined by least squares; each beat is the detected onset nearest the fitted grid, localised on a >3 kHz 0.5 ms RMS envelope; downbeat = beat phase with most 200-1200 Hz energy in the 80 ms after onset
